Native macOS menu bar app for push-to-talk voice-to-text. Transcription runs locally on the Apple Neural Engine; optional cleanup via Apple Intelligence, GitHub Copilot, or an OpenAI-compatible API.
Microphone access is needed to convert your speech to text.
Accessibility access is needed to detect the Fn key for push-to-talk and to paste transcribed text into other apps.
